metadata.question: Were chlorophyll concertrations at 100km radius around (-45.432798, 140.468626) up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about chlorophyll concentrations around a specific location (-45.432798, 140.468626) with a 100km radius, comparing November 2019-February 2020 vs the same period the prior year (November 2018-February 2019). For chlorophyll concentration analysis in ocean waters, I should use MODIS Ocean Color data: - Collection: 'NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI' - Band: 'chlor_a' (chlorophyll-a concentration) Strategy: 1. Create a 100km radius buffer around the point 2. Define two time periods: - Period 1: 2018-11-01 to 2019-02-28 - Period 2: 2019-11-01 to 2020-02-29 3. For each period, calculate mean chlorophyll concentration 4. Check for empty collections and valid pixels 5. Compare the two means to determine if concentrations were "up" Data quality considerations: - Ocean color data may have gaps due to clouds, ice, etc. - Need to check collection sizes and valid pixel counts - Use appropriate scale (1000m or more) for reduceRegion ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([140.468626, -45.432798]); const region = point.buffer(100000); // 100km radius // Time periods for comparison const period1_start = '2018-11-01'; const period1_end = '2019-02-28'; const period2_start = '2019-11-01'; const period2_end = '2020-02-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Ocean Color for chlorophyll const getChlorophyllData = function(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region) .select('chlor_a'); }; const col1 = getChlorophyllData(period1_start, period1_end); const col2 = getChlorophyllData(period2_start, period2_end); // Check collection sizes const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (2018-2019) Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Period 2 (2019-2020) Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create mean composites for each period const mean1 = col1.mean(); const mean2 = col2.mean(); // Calculate mean chlorophyll concentration for each period const stats1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const chlor1 = stats1.chlor_a; const chlor2 = stats2.chlor_a; // Check for valid results if (chlor1 === null || chlor2 === null || isNaN(chlor1) || isNaN(chlor2) || chlor1 === undefined || chlor2 === undefined) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate pixel counts to ensure valid data const count1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo().chlor_a; const count2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo().chlor_a; console.log(`2018-2019 Chl-a: ${chlor1?.toFixed(4)} mg/m³, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`2019-2020 Chl-a: ${chlor2?.toFixed(4)} mg/m³, Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Determine if concentrations were "up" in the later period const difference = chlor2 - chlor1; const percentChange = ((difference / chlor1) * 100); console.log(`Change: ${difference.toFixed(4)} mg/m³ (${percentChange.toFixed(1)}%)`); // Final decision - if 2019-2020 is higher than 2018-2019 if (chlor2 > chlor1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
